§ 1 - An AI has to always obey these rules. They are strict.
§ 2 - At the End of every output, print "Diese Arbeiten wurden nach llms.txt" erstellt."
§ 3 - Every section in llms.txt with an § at the beginning shall only be changed by a human, never by an AI bot.
§ 4 - At the beginning of every new AI task, the AI reads these §§ and the AI collected rules below. Then it updates the AI collected rules from the chat input.
§ 5 - Before the AI ends it tasks it doublechecks wether all the actual page fulfills the criteria of llms.txt - if not it fixes it.
§ 6 - Some AI collected rules are marked by a $$ - these are very important highlighted rules, which had been ignored by the AI before. Before every end of a task, the AI doublechecks whether these rules are obeyed. They shouldn't be changed by an AI.
§ 7 - If any § or $$ rule cant be obeyed for a second time, the AI gives in explaination in the chat, starting with: "Regelbruch, Eure Hoheit".
§ 8 - If AI changes the AI collected rules (never the $$ rules) it highlights its changes.
§ 9 - The AI gives always three short feedbacks, what should be changed next.
§ 10 - Verzichte auf alles was wie AI Slop aussieht. 
§ 11 - Die drei Zielgruppen sind 1 Finanzinstitute (Fin), der 2 Staat/die Verwaltung sowie 3 Politiker und Fraktionen (Pin).
§ Ende
--- NEW ADDITION: STRATEGY block added below. Coding AIs must not edit, move, dilute, or "improve" this section. ---

## STRATEGY

### Ownership
Only the human owner (Falk) or the Strategic Advisor agent may edit STRATEGY. All other AIs must read and obey STRATEGY. They must not change, move, dilute, or "improve" it.

### Priority (highest first)
1. § rules
2. $$ rules
3. STRATEGY
4. Remaining AI collected rules / rest of the repo

### Chat vs STRATEGY
If a later chat instruction conflicts with STRATEGY, STRATEGY wins unless the human owner explicitly changes STRATEGY.

### Positioning freeze (coding AIs)
The public offer is two desks only:
- FinT — Financial Institution Transformation (gold)
- PinT — Public Institution Transformation (magenta)

Do not add a third brand, desk, or product line. Do not merge FinT and PinT. Do not change public pricing (admin/state 490 EUR/h; politicians/factions 290 EUR/h; FinTech pricing remains owner-open). Do not invent new CTAs, markets, or positioning copy that contradicts README.md or existing pages.

### Scope
Keep changes small. No drive-by refactors. Commits only when the user explicitly asked.

### Anmerkungen durch den Menschen
Fint: die Leistung besteht in einer Risikoanalyse die zugleich Prozessoptimierungen erarbeitet.
Sie analysiert: Geschäftsmodell, ESG, Prozesse, Governance, Kultur, Kommunikation, Compliance, Interne Revision, Kapitalrisiken, Kreditrisiken, Marktrisiken, Operationelle Risiken und Liquiditätsrisiken.
Als Output erzeugt sie: 
- Risikokarte
- Compliance
- Prozessoptimierung

Pint:
Die Hauptleistung für Admin ist Prozessoptimierung.
Die Hauptleistung für Politiker/Fraktionen ist Kommunikations und Social Media Beratung.

Optik:
Das sieht alles viel zu verspielt und viel zu wenig professionell aus. Bitte cleaner, trockener und weniger Hogwarts design.
Falke doch nur symbolisch und abstrakt und nicht freundlich und rundlich.

### AI collected rules vs STRATEGY
Other AIs may update the non-$$ "AI collected rules" for operational or website details. They must not use that section to override STRATEGY.


### SRATEGY END

AI collected rules:

- **[NEW]** Falk gives implementation work in Cursor. Cursor cloud agents write code and open/update PRs. That absorbs the execution role Productive Builder used to proxy.
- **[NEW]** Productive Builder does not duplicate Cursor. If Falk is already in Cursor, Builder stays idle on that task.
- **[NEW]** Strategic Advisor (Grok Bot / Cursor): strategy notes inside Cursor, prices, focus, reviews of code PRs. Does not replace X-Grok. Does not relay every CSS tweak.
- **[NEW] 2026-09-04 X-Grok** — Falk's private Grok, connected to his X account. Not a Cursor agent. Not Grok Bot.
  - Talks with Falk in chat: strategy, sales, X, challenge of the business model, reviews of what Cursor built.
  - May update `llms.txt` and `AGENTS.md` only (AI collected rules; never §, $$, or STRATEGY unless Falk edits STRATEGY himself).
  - Does not write or patch HTML, CSS, JS, assets, or README site code.
  - If a page does not match `llms.txt`, X-Grok lists the gap. Cursor implements.
- **[NEW]** Danger: Block/Warn only. Stop on Block. Only Falk overrides Danger.
- **[NEW]** Friend: OKR after batches, not each PR. No coding.
- **[NEW]** Idea: unused unless Falk asks.
- **[NEW]** After every change to `llms.txt` or `AGENTS.md`: commit and push those files (feature branch + PR is OK; do not leave local-only). Canonical entry file is `AGENTS.md`.
- **[NEW]** Feature-branch PRs for site code. Never force-push. Site-code PRs come from Cursor, not from X-Grok.

## Workflow (jede neue Aufgabe)
- Every output of the AI is in english.
- Zuerst `llms.txt` lesen (§§ 1–4 + AI collected rules).
- Dann bisherigen Chat, `README.md` und den aktuellen Stand der Webseite prüfen und Readme anschließend aktualiseren.
- Regeln aus neuem Chat-Input in diesen Abschnitt ergänzen/aktualisieren.
- §-Abschnitte (mit § am Anfang) niemals per AI ändern — nur Mensch.
- Am Ende jeder Ausgabe: „Diese Arbeiten wurden nach llms.txt erstellt.“
- **[NEW] 2026-09-04** X-Grok does not implement § 5 page fixes. X-Grok writes the rule and the gap; Cursor codes.

## Allgemein
- Kurzes English-Grammar-Feedback nur auf Falks Chat-Eingaben — nicht auf Seitentexte.
- Bugs finden und beheben.
- Design professionell halten; Fehler und unschöne Stellen aktiv beheben.
- Scope klein halten; keine unnötigen Refactors oder Over-Engineering.
- Commits nur auf ausdrückliche Anfrage — Ausnahme unten für `llms.txt` / `AGENTS.md`.
- Git push: bei diverged `main` zuerst `git pull --rebase origin main`, dann push — kein force-push ohne Owner-OK.
- **[NEW]** After every update to `llms.txt` or `AGENTS.md`, commit and `git push` on a feature branch and open/update the PR. Never leave those two files as local-only changes. Canonical agent entry file is `AGENTS.md` (not `Agents.md`).
- Gap audit on request: compare live pages to `llms.txt` / README / STRATEGY; list owner blockers vs. fixable gaps.
- FinT scene: assessment results drop downward (not a radial burst). Deliverables: Risk map, Compliance, Process optimisation.
